major_cooldowns.name: Ultimate Penitence
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it as a major healing and defensive cooldown separate from Evangelism, timed for a heavy damage window; as Voidweaver open the cast with Mind Blast to deploy your Rift first, and spell-queue Void Shield just before the cast finishes so it does not interrupt the channel.

major_cooldowns.name: Evangelism
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it to ramp Atonement fast: it casts a free Power Word: Radiance and makes your next two Power Word: Radiance casts instant, so time it separately from Ultimate Penitence.

defensives.name: Pain Suppression
defensives.usage_rule: Cast it on the ally about to take heavy damage when you cannot out-heal it through Atonement alone.

rules.description: Keep Shadow Word: Pain up on your target
rules.action: Refresh Shadow Word: Pain before it drops under 20 seconds remaining.

rules.description: Hold Power Word: Radiance charges for Evangelism
rules.action: Spend Power Word: Radiance on mini-ramps as it comes up, but bank two charges ahead of your Evangelism ramp.

rules.description: Hold Power Word: Radiance charges for Ultimate Penitence
rules.action: Spend Power Word: Radiance on mini-ramps as it comes up, but bank two charges ahead of your Ultimate Penitence cast.

rules.description: Mind Blast into Ultimate Penitence into Void Shield
rules.action: As Voidweaver, deploy your Rift with Mind Blast, then cast Ultimate Penitence, then spell-queue Void Shield right before the cast finishes.

rules.description: Shadow Word: Death replaces Smite in execute
rules.action: Swap your Smite filler to Shadow Word: Death once the target is in execute range.
